# NOSOCOMIAL PNEUMONIA WITH PSEUDOMONAS AERUGINOSA

Single drug therapy is as effective as combination therapy once susceptibility

results are known.

# Duration of therapy

Treat for 14 days. Patients who respond promptly and are no longer intubated may

be treated for as few as 7 days.

# Empiric Treatment:

See below for oral therapy or history of multi-drug resistant Pseudomonas

Preferred

[Cefepime 2 gm IV q8h R](psjizid-cefepime-2-gm-iv-q8h)

< OR >

[Piperacillin-tazobactam 4.5 gm IV q6h R](psjizid-pip-taz-4-5gm-iv-q6h-ne-extinf-ci-cefep-metro)

Alternative

[Assessment of Beta-lactam Reaction](beta-lactam-allergy-assessment)

[Ciprofloxacin 400 mg IV q8h R,DI](psjizid-ciproflox-400mg-iv-q8h)

# History of multi-drug resistant Pseudomonas

Consult ID if Carbapenemase gene detected (IMP, KPC, NDM, OXA-48, VIM)

[<ADD> Tobramycin 5 mg/kg IV once R,O to one of the regimens above](psjizid-tobramycin-5-mg-kg-iv-once)

# Oral therapy (usually given after several days of intravenous therapy)

# if isolate known sensitive to fluoroquinolone

[Ciprofloxacin 750 mg PO q12h R,DI](psjzid-ciprofloxacin-500mg-po-q12h)
